d9ad221e-007e-455b-8cbd-6815f3ee1ef8/Eve.en: The night was awash with a sea of stars, with a soft breeze wafting. <NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly caught a rustling sound from the roadside shadows, as though someone were stealing past with feather-light steps. <NL>The sound was faint, drifting in and out of earshot. Was it merely the wind rustling the trees, or something fishy going on?
d9ad221e-007e-455b-8cbd-6815f3ee1ef8/Eve.cn: 是夜，星河烂漫，晚风轻拂。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正行于路上，忽闻道旁暗处窸窣作响，似有轻缓步履踩过。<NL>其声若有若无，时断时续，不知是风过林梢，还是另有蹊跷……

feef8dac-4582-40d6-ad5a-dc09a7eb9404/Eve.en: Following the noise to investigate, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> found no one nearby.<NL>Yet just as they were about to turn and leave, a sudden swaying of tree shadows caught the corner of the eye. Amidst the quivering leaves, stood a slender silhouette. <NL>With such stealthy movements, who else could it be but Jade Cicada? <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> figured it out and turned to look at the silhouette...
feef8dac-4582-40d6-ad5a-dc09a7eb9404/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循声上前查探，四下却阒然无人，<NL>正欲转身离去，余光忽见树影摇曳，婆娑间隐有一道清瘦身影悄然伫立。<NL>这般行迹，不是玉蝉又是何人。<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下了然，遂从容转头望去……

b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Eve.en: Jade Cicada smiled faintly and said:<NL>"I will first wait quietly above the Demise Abyss,<NL>and once Taiwu is ready, we will descend together to investigate."<NL><NL>With that, Jade Cicada gave a solemn bow, then leaped into the night sky and vanished in an instant...
b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Eve.cn: 玉蝉淡淡一笑，只道：<NL>“玉蝉便先在无生渊上静候，<NL>待太吾准备妥当，再一同下渊探个究竟。”<NL><NL>言罢，玉蝉郑重一拜，旋即掠入夜空，转瞬不见了踪影……
b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Eve.ru: Цикада из Нефрита слабо улыбнулась и сказала:<NL>"Сначала я буду спокойно ждать над бездной Гибели,<NL>и как только Тайу будет готов, мы вместе спустимся на разведку."<NL><NL>С этими словами Цикада Нефрит торжественно поклонилась, затем взмыла в ночное небо и в одно мгновение исчезла...

b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Opt.en: (If so, prepare to venture into the Demise Abyss...)
b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Opt.cn: （既然如此，或可择日往无生渊一探……）
b0a98518-6e33-4ddc-82ca-0ec8bbb2c661/Opt.ru: (Если это так, приготовьтесь отправиться в бездну Гибели...)

f27d5fed-9b76-4573-982f-9e25e734d774/Eve.en: Hardly had <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> set foot in the Veil Scar Sect when a small cluster of disciples was seen whispering in low voices. <NL>Known for hiding their whereabouts, Veil Scar Sect disciples rarely congregated.<NL>The sight of them whispering in a huddle was rare...
f27d5fed-9b76-4573-982f-9e25e734d774/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>甫至界青门，便见三两弟子立在一处低声相谈。<NL>界青门人素来行踪诡秘、各行其是，<NL>这般聚谈倒是少见……
f27d5fed-9b76-4573-982f-9e25e734d774/Eve.ru: Едва ли у него был <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> ступил в Секту Завесы, когда увидел небольшую группу учеников, перешептывающихся тихими голосами. <NL>Известные тем, что скрывали свое местонахождение, ученики Секты Завесы редко собирались вместе.<NL>Видеть, как они шепчутся, сбившись в кучку, было редкостью...

2a7d0cae-6a3f-4646-be57-5eb753a831af/Eve.en: Several Disciple sensed someone approaching, tensed up, and showed signs of wariness,<NL>Upon recognizing the figure as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, they all dispersed their killing intent and saluted.<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> noticed that the Veil Scar Disciple had made an exception to gather together, their behavior unusual,<NL>after a moment of thought, assumed it must be related to the strange sounds from the Demise Abyss that Jade Cicada mentioned...
2a7d0cae-6a3f-4646-be57-5eb753a831af/Eve.cn: 几名弟子察觉有人走近，身形一肃，隐有戒备，<NL>待看清来人是<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，众人方才敛去周身杀气，拱手见礼。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见界青弟子竟破例聚首，举止反常，<NL>略一思忖，便料想定与玉蝉所言的无生渊异响有关……

2a7d0cae-6a3f-4646-be57-5eb753a831af/Opt.en: Are you discussing about the unearthly noises from the Demise Abyss?
2a7d0cae-6a3f-4646-be57-5eb753a831af/Opt.cn: 各位可是在说无生渊下传出异响之事？
2a7d0cae-6a3f-4646-be57-5eb753a831af/Opt.ru: Вы обсуждаете неземные звуки, доносящиеся из Бездны Гибели?

ecc66db7-b616-45ab-a1e6-427df17ac4a1/Eve.en: upon hearing this, the Veil Scar Sect disciples cupped their fists in a parting salute.<NL>In a blur of motion, they vanished into the surrounding shadows, leaving not a trace behind. Looking at the Veil Scar Cliff, <NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pondered silently.<NL>In that azure-flamed illusion of the past, the real Benevolence had stated that the Asura Maiden had awakened, though her power remained diminished.<NL>Could it be that she has returned to the peak of her power?
ecc66db7-b616-45ab-a1e6-427df17ac4a1/Eve.cn: 此话言毕，众界青门弟子便各自抱拳，<NL>随后身形一闪，便没入四下阴影之中，再无声息。<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望着界青崖，心中暗忖，<NL>昔日青焰幻象之中，真万善曾言修罗女已然醒转，但力量似乎并未复原，<NL>莫非……如今她已恢复了力量？

ecc66db7-b616-45ab-a1e6-427df17ac4a1/Opt.en: (Rendezvous with Jade Cicada at the precipice of the Demise Abyss to investigate it)
ecc66db7-b616-45ab-a1e6-427df17ac4a1/Opt.cn: （玉蝉想必已在无生渊畔等候，渊下究竟是何情形，还需亲自前往一探……）
ecc66db7-b616-45ab-a1e6-427df17ac4a1/Opt.ru: (Встреча с цикадой Нефрит на краю пропасти Гибели, чтобы исследовать ее)

3fe3a898-3d9f-44ab-ba78-75826c3f771b/Eve.en: The Demise Abyss is in endless depths,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> can only faintly see a few ghostly flames flickering,<NL>it's said that assassins from the Veil Scar Sect receive assassination contracts at this cliff...
3fe3a898-3d9f-44ab-ba78-75826c3f771b/Eve.cn: 无生渊深不见底，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只隐隐约约看见几点鬼火摇曳，<NL>据说界青门杀手便是在此断崖接取暗杀委托……
3fe3a898-3d9f-44ab-ba78-75826c3f771b/Eve.ru: Бездна гибели находится в бесконечных глубинах,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> могу лишь слабо разглядеть несколько мерцающих призрачных огоньков,<NL>говорят, что убийцы из Секты Завесы получают контракты на убийство на этом утесе...

241a5b48-aa46-4fcb-ab5a-c4d5d01171e6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> walked to the edge of the Demise Abyss; all around was empty and silent,<NL>only the biting abyss wind carrying a chill spiraled up from the extreme depths.<NL><NL>Suddenly, a deep rumbling sound came from deep within the abyss.<NL>In just a few breaths, the dull rumble was pierced by the sharp clang of Metal collision, directly entering <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s ears...
241a5b48-aa46-4fcb-ab5a-c4d5d01171e6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行至无生渊畔，周遭空寂，<NL>唯有凛冽的渊风裹挟着寒意，自极深处盘旋而上。<NL><NL>忽然间，渊底深处传来一阵沉闷的隆隆震响。<NL>不过数息，那闷响便被铮然的金铁交击声划破，直灌入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>耳中……

d94e5e1f-5fb5-423e-b9ae-e0c13268d8b4/Eve.en: Staring at the item in the hand, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> deliberated for a while before putting it inside the travel bag. <NL>Jade Cicada remained rooted to the spot, staring at the place where Alina had faded away, seemingly unable to recover from the recent chaos. <NL><NL>The blowing abyssal wind gently fluttered their robes. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> cast a final glance back at the Demise Abyss.<NL>With nothing left to say, they departed from the Veil Scar Cliff together...
d94e5e1f-5fb5-423e-b9ae-e0c13268d8b4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望着掌中之物，沉吟片刻，方将其收入行囊。<NL>玉蝉仍立于原处，面向阿黎那消散之处，似仍未从方才种种中回过神来。<NL><NL>渊风徐来，拂动二人衣袂，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回首望了一眼无生渊，<NL>二人不再多言，随即并肩离开了界青崖……

6220450f-8422-4ed9-8429-670f16a8af5b/Eve.en: Strolling along the path, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly caught a subtle anomaly in the wind behind,like the faint rustle of light footsteps upon fallen leaves. <NL>A familiar figure was standing quietly a few zhang behind, framed by the slanting sunbeams and sparse shadows...<NL>Who else could this be but Jade Cicada?
6220450f-8422-4ed9-8429-670f16a8af5b/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正行于路上，忽觉身后风声微异，似有轻履踏叶之音。<NL>回首望去，但见数丈之外，一抹熟悉的身影静立于斜阳疏影间，<NL>此人不是玉蝉，又是何人……

25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Eve.en: With a subtle smile, Jade Cicada closed the distance to greet. <NL>Though her profound power was utterly concealed, a sharp, lethal edge could be vaguely sensed in her every bearing,<NL>all too reminiscent of Ah-li...
25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Eve.cn: 玉蝉唇角微扬，举步迎上前来。<NL>但见她周身气息内敛深沉，举止间隐隐透出几分凌厉与肃杀之气，<NL>竟与阿黎那颇有几分神似……
25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Eve.ru: С едва заметной улыбкой Цикада Нефрит приблизилась, чтобы поздороваться. <NL>Хотя ее глубинная сила была полностью скрыта, в каждой ее осанке смутно ощущалась острая, смертоносная грань,<NL>все это слишком напоминает А-ли...

25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Opt.en: It appeared that you had great time with Alina these days...
25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Opt.cn: 看来这些时日，你与阿黎那相处甚为融洽……
25ca55cb-b3c6-455f-8bad-66f8204f5f6b/Opt.ru: Оказалось, что вы прекрасно провели время с Алиной в эти дни...

0ef6505b-4038-4712-9c01-c4d66f8985e7/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded slightly, and said with a gentle smile,<NL>"She spends most of her time slumbering, only waking now and then to say a few words to me. <NL>She still has quite a temper..."<NL><NL>Jade Cicada paused for a while, her expression turning serious,<NL>"I have something to tell you..."
0ef6505b-4038-4712-9c01-c4d66f8985e7/Eve.cn: 玉蝉轻轻颔首，浅笑道：<NL>“她大部分时间都在沉睡，偶尔醒转，与我说上几句话。<NL>不过……脾气倒是不小……”<NL><NL>说至此处，玉蝉微微一顿，旋即敛了笑意，正色道：<NL>“今日前来，却是有一事相告……”
0ef6505b-4038-4712-9c01-c4d66f8985e7/Eve.ru: Цикада Нефрит слегка кивнула и сказала с нежной улыбкой,<NL>- Большую часть своего времени она проводит во сне, просыпаясь только время от времени, чтобы сказать мне несколько слов. <NL>У нее все еще довольно вспыльчивый характер..."<NL><NL>Цикада Нефрит помолчала некоторое время, выражение ее лица стало серьезным,<NL>"Я должен тебе кое-что сказать..."

ceaa725a-4ea9-4f83-8db3-b2fbd1c616fb/Eve.en: "She woke up for a moment yesterday and said a few words to me...<NL>The Silent Star she turned into when she dissipated was a thing from beyond the heavens, originally connected to the stars above. If used as a guide, it could reflect deeper Star Fields...<NL><NL>Jade Cicada's expression turned serious, and she continued:<NL>"I think... the Astral Terrace originally had the ability to stargaze, and now I have also inherited her power.<NL>Perhaps I can help you activate more Astral Terraces to reflect more sources of Star Fortune malevolence..."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(The Construction limit of the Astral Terrace has been raised to 10...)</color>
ceaa725a-4ea9-4f83-8db3-b2fbd1c616fb/Eve.cn: “她昨日醒了片刻，与我说了一些话……<NL>她消散之时所化的寂星乃是天外之物，本与天上星辰相连，若以之为引，便可映照更渊远的星域……<NL><NL>玉蝉神色一正，继续道：<NL>“我想……奇纹星台本有观星之能，而我如今亦承了她的力量。<NL>或可助你开启更多奇纹星台，映照更多星运煞源……”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（奇纹星台的建造上限已提升至10座……）</color>

5b87bef9-a1a9-4e09-ae9f-b08977e37bb0/Eve.en: "Staying with her these days has also greatly improved my cultivation,<NL>I can now lead Star Fortune into the world, and from now on, I will naturally help you with matters of Star Fortune..."<NL><NL>A smile flickered in Jade Cicada's eyes as she continued:<NL><NL>"She also said that the Asura clan always repays kindness, you used her Supreme grinding bones to escape your predicament,<NL>she helps you connect with the stars, and from then on, you owe each other nothing..."
5b87bef9-a1a9-4e09-ae9f-b08977e37bb0/Eve.cn: “这段时日与她相处，我的修为亦精进不少，<NL>如今我已可引星运入世，往后星运之事，我自当助你一臂之力……”<NL><NL>玉蝉眼中掠过笑意，继续道：<NL><NL>“她还说，阿修罗一族有恩必报，你借她绝磨骨脱困，<NL>她助你与星辰相连，自此两不相欠……”

5b87bef9-a1a9-4e09-ae9f-b08977e37bb0/Opt.en: Settled? She certainly keeps her accounts clear. Very well... let it be settled...
5b87bef9-a1a9-4e09-ae9f-b08977e37bb0/Opt.cn: 两不相欠？她倒是算得清楚，也罢，便当与她两清了……
5b87bef9-a1a9-4e09-ae9f-b08977e37bb0/Opt.ru: Устроился? Она, конечно, ведет свои счета четко. Очень хорошо... пусть это будет улажено...

347d7e7d-2959-498f-b877-e6b8baa0cb4d/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded, walking side by side with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> into the deepening twilight.<NL><NL>The two chatted idly about recent Cultivation gains and various Star Fortune matters.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> felt that Jade Cicada's current Footwork Arts and demeanor were much sharper and more efficient than before.<NL><NL>Unconsciously, their figures gradually merged into the vast mountain scenery, disappearing into the evening glow...
347d7e7d-2959-498f-b877-e6b8baa0cb4d/Eve.cn: 玉蝉颔首，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>并肩向着暮色深处行去。<NL><NL>二人闲叙着近日来的修行所得与星运诸事。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只觉玉蝉如今的身法气度，较往昔凌厉干练了许多。<NL><NL>不知不觉间，两人的身影已渐渐融入苍茫山色，消隐于晚照之中……

c5497d03-0017-49e4-9de2-b5fa4d4ea91b/Eve.en: Yuchan paused for thought, then shook her head,<NL>"I'm fine. It's just that I can hear whispers in my mind. <NL>Maybe it is her voice..."<NL><NL>Before her words had fully faded, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> caught a faint sound beneath their feet. <NL>Looking down, they spotted an object nestled in a stone crevice, glowing with a soft, warm radiance.
c5497d03-0017-49e4-9de2-b5fa4d4ea91b/Eve.cn: 玉蝉沉吟片刻，随即摇头道：<NL>“并无大碍，只是神识之中，似多了些呓语。<NL>想来应是她的声音……”<NL><NL>话音未落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽听得脚下传来一声轻响。<NL>低头望去，便见方才阿黎那所立之处，有一物静静卧于石隙之间，正自内里透出温润薄光……

c5497d03-0017-49e4-9de2-b5fa4d4ea91b/Opt.en: It is... (Reaches down to retrieve it...)
c5497d03-0017-49e4-9de2-b5fa4d4ea91b/Opt.ru: Так и есть... (Наклоняется, чтобы поднять его...)

d8b731a9-254f-474c-8ba8-6c6a0ea7230d/Eve.en: Moments later, Alina's eyes fluttered open, a cyan hue in her pupils deepening. With a faint smile, she said, "It is done." <NL>She raised a hand to toss the Demonbane Bone back to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, but it crumbled into dust, slipping through her fingers. <NL>Alina froze for a heartbeat, then shrugged, meeting their gaze with a wry grimace,<NL><NL>"Well... I suppose I owe you one more now. Come, let me see you out of this place." <NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Lost Demonbane Bone)</color>
d8b731a9-254f-474c-8ba8-6c6a0ea7230d/Eve.cn: 片刻之后，阿黎那双眸轻启，瞳中青色愈盛，唇角微扬：“成了。”<NL>随即抬手欲将绝魔骨抛还<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，却见掌中之物已化作齑粉，自指缝间簌簌滑落。<NL>阿黎那微微一怔，旋即耸了耸肩，望向二人，无奈道：<NL><NL>“罢了……如此便多还你一份人情，我先带你们离开此地罢。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（失去绝魔骨）</color>

d8b731a9-254f-474c-8ba8-6c6a0ea7230d/Opt.en: It's easy for you to run up a debt... Jade Cicada and I can find our own way up.Why would we need you to lead the way?
d8b731a9-254f-474c-8ba8-6c6a0ea7230d/Opt.cn: 这人情倒是欠得干脆……我与玉蝉自可回到渊上，何须由你带我二人离开？
d8b731a9-254f-474c-8ba8-6c6a0ea7230d/Opt.ru: Вам легко влезть в долги... Мы с Цикадой Нефрит сами найдем дорогу наверх.Зачем нам нужно, чтобы вы указывали путь?

f7af7363-c98e-4e96-8c65-0df7a128b799/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> dismissed it as nothing more than a passing ripple, <NL>and departed immediately with weightier matters at hand.
f7af7363-c98e-4e96-8c65-0df7a128b799/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>只当是寻常动静，<NL>又思及有要事在身，当即举步离开了此地……
f7af7363-c98e-4e96-8c65-0df7a128b799/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> отмахнулся от этого как от не более чем мимолетной ряби, <NL>и немедленно отбыл, уладив более важные дела.

412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Eve.en: The sound ceased. A figure leaped nimbly from the branches, landing gracefully.<NL>Stepping from the shadows, Jade Cicada spoke softly,<NL><NL>"You caught me."
412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Eve.cn: 响动倏止，那身影轻巧一纵，便自树间翩然落地，<NL>便见玉蝉自暗处款款步出，轻声道：<NL><NL>“被你发现了。”
412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Eve.ru: Звук прекратился. С ветвей проворно спрыгнула фигура, грациозно приземлившись.<NL>Выйдя из тени, Цикада из Нефрита тихо заговорила,<NL><NL>- Ты поймал меня.

412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Opt.en: If you truly intended to hide, you wouldn't have made that noise. You drew me here. Is there something urgent?
412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Opt.cn: 你若真想藏身，又岂会弄出声响。特意引我过来，可是有什么要紧事？
412f08b1-7665-43e2-89e2-1efbde01434a/Opt.ru: Если бы вы действительно намеревались спрятаться, вы бы не производили такого шума. Ты притянул меня сюда. Есть что-то срочное?

35dc7996-0c1d-4359-8192-1134c4682a40/Eve.en: Jade Cicada smiled faintly. "Nothing escapes your notice. <NL>I did have something important to discuss with you..."
35dc7996-0c1d-4359-8192-1134c4682a40/Eve.cn: 玉蝉唇角含笑，只道：<NL><NL>“到底还是瞒不过你。<NL>今日前来，确是有要事相商……”
35dc7996-0c1d-4359-8192-1134c4682a40/Eve.ru: Цикада из Нефрита слабо улыбнулась. - Ничто не ускользнет от твоего внимания. <NL>Мне действительно нужно было обсудить с тобой кое-что важное..."

1c622235-1019-4e6b-b426-09800f202333/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded gently, her expression growing more serious, and said slowly:<NL><NL>"Lately, the wisp of azure flame in my heart has often stirred restlessly,<NL>in a mysterious way, I feel this matter may be related to the Asura Maiden from the past...<NL><NL>To investigate, I secretly returned to the Veil Scar Sect, and at the Demise Abyss I heard terrifying strange noises from below,<NL>the sounds surging and shaking, as if thousands of troops were Slaughtering at the bottom of the abyss..."
1c622235-1019-4e6b-b426-09800f202333/Eve.cn: 玉蝉轻轻颔首，神色凝重了几分，缓声道：<NL><NL>“近来，我心口的那缕青焰时常生出异动，<NL>冥冥之中，只觉此事或与昔日那位修罗女有关……<NL><NL>为探虚实，我暗中回了一趟界青门，竟在无生渊畔听得渊下传来阵阵骇人异响，<NL>其声翻涌震荡，恍若千军万马正于渊底厮杀……”

1c622235-1019-4e6b-b426-09800f202333/Opt.en: Thousands of soldiers battling in the deep abyss... Could this be related to the cloud battlefield from the visions?
1c622235-1019-4e6b-b426-09800f202333/Opt.cn: 渊底竟有千军万马之声……莫非与此前幻象中所见的云端战场有关……
1c622235-1019-4e6b-b426-09800f202333/Opt.ru: Тысячи солдат сражаются в глубокой пропасти... Может ли это быть связано с облачным полем битвы из видений?

35e7fa64-e9d9-474c-9432-8527ffa23a0e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> heard what Jade Cicada said and couldn't help recalling what he had seen from the azure flame before——<NL><NL>Golden-armored heavenly armies fighting Asura in the clouds, the Asura clan defeated, and the Asura Maiden fell from the nine heavens to the bottom of the abyss.<NL>The azure flame illusion was the Asura Maiden's memory, now the azure flame in Jade Cicada's heart stirs, and the sounds of Slaughtering come from below the abyss...
35e7fa64-e9d9-474c-9432-8527ffa23a0e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>听得玉蝉所言，不由忆起从前自青焰中所见——<NL><NL>金甲天军与阿修罗鏖战云端，阿修罗一族败退，修罗女方才自九霄坠落渊底。<NL>青焰幻象既是修罗女的记忆，如今玉蝉心口青焰异动，渊下又传出厮杀之声……

35e7fa64-e9d9-474c-9432-8527ffa23a0e/Opt.en: Could that turmoil in the depths be the echoes of that battle?
35e7fa64-e9d9-474c-9432-8527ffa23a0e/Opt.cn: 莫非……这渊底传出的，正是当年战场的回响？
35e7fa64-e9d9-474c-9432-8527ffa23a0e/Opt.ru: Могло ли это смятение в глубинах быть отголосками той битвы?

f92c8a33-8930-47dc-aa03-fda26e47dd86/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded, "I suspect the same. <NL>It seemed abnormal, so I did some digging within the Veil Scar Sect.<NL>The disciples whisper that the number of disciples who descend into the abyss and never return has surged to several times the usual. <NL><NL>Yet, when I searched the abyss myself, I found nothing: no Asura maiden, no phantom armies...<NL>not even a single trace of the missing disciples."
f92c8a33-8930-47dc-aa03-fda26e47dd86/Eve.cn: 玉蝉闻言颔首道：<NL><NL>“我亦有此猜测。<NL>事出反常，我便在界青门内查探了一番，<NL>据门中弟子私下议论，近日下渊后一去不返的门人，竟比往常多出数倍。<NL><NL>可我下渊探查，莫说那修罗女和千军万马，<NL>便是那些失踪的弟子，亦是毫无踪迹……

36e47a6e-20ae-426b-a900-3aa2ff41396d/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded with a severe countenance,<NL><NL>"All these signs point to the Asura Maiden. <NL>I scoured the abyss but found nothing; either some force is shielding her,<NL>or she is ensnared and unable to break free.<NL><NL>You are wise, and I believe you know how to solve it.<NL>This is beyond my ability, so I come for your help. Will you go search the Demise Abyss with me?"
36e47a6e-20ae-426b-a900-3aa2ff41396d/Eve.cn: 玉蝉颔首，正色道：<NL><NL>“诸般异状合在一处，只怕皆是因那修罗女而起。<NL>我在渊底遍寻未果，料想渊底定是有何物遮蔽了她行迹，<NL>亦或是她正困于某处，难以脱身……<NL><NL>太吾传人见多识广，或能寻得破解之法，<NL>此事我独力难为，故而特来相请，不知太吾可愿与我同往无生渊一探？”

36e47a6e-20ae-426b-a900-3aa2ff41396d/Opt.en: I will give this careful consideration...

dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Eve.en: The group exchanged glances before one of the Veil Scar disciples spoke up,<NL><NL>"Yes... Might you also be here for this?"
dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Eve.cn: 几人对望一眼，其中一位界青门弟子便说道：<NL><NL>“正是……莫非太吾传人亦是为此事而来？”
dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Eve.ru: Группа обменялась взглядами, прежде чем заговорил один из учеников со шрамом от вуали,<NL><NL>"Да... Не могли бы вы тоже быть здесь из-за этого?"

dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Opt.en: Yes. That is precisely why I came.
dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Opt.cn: 不错，我正是为此事而来……
dd00aea5-b320-4889-9928-474b274609ca/Opt.ru: Да. Именно поэтому я и пришел.

4189b31e-dac6-4a52-99ea-15eee60e058a/Eve.en: The Veil Scar Sect disciple nodded slightly upon hearing it,<NL>"Outsiders aren't supposed to know it, but if it's you, an exception can be made."<NL><NL>After a brief pause, he added, "The infighting within our sect has finally ceased since the battle above the Abyss, thanks to you.<NL>We have since cast aside our petty rivalries and vowed to fulfill our commissions by the rules..."
4189b31e-dac6-4a52-99ea-15eee60e058a/Eve.cn: 那界青门人闻言，微微颔首道：<NL>“此事本不应为外人所道，但倘若是太吾，知晓倒也无妨……”<NL><NL>随即沉吟片刻，便又道：<NL>“托太吾传人出手，自无生渊上那一战之后，门内便鲜少再有同门相残之事，<NL>我等本以为免了无谓的争斗，此后只需按规矩接取委托便是……”

983ca115-06e8-4bfa-b979-17fbd0f9c680/Eve.en: The Veil Scar Sect disciple heaved a long sigh.<NL><NL>"However, we lack the strength to delve into the Seventh Floor. To venture there blindly would be to court death.<NL>Only you possess the power to resolve such peril, Taiwu." <NL><NL>We would be deeply indebted if you would investigate the abyss and uncover the truth."
983ca115-06e8-4bfa-b979-17fbd0f9c680/Eve.cn: 那界青弟子长叹一声道：<NL><NL>“我等修为不足，若是贸然深入渊底第七层亦是平添伤亡，<NL>这等棘手之事，想来唯有太吾传人出面方可化解。<NL><NL>太吾若有意亲自下渊探查，寻得几分究竟，于门中自是再好不过……”

2a3b1a5e-3c32-4558-a704-412e32b485d4/Eve.en: "But lately, strange noises have been echoing from the depths of the abyss, as if an entire army were locked in battle below.<NL>Many disciples who descended have vanished, and our commissions are piling up...<NL><NL>What's more, these sounds seem to come from beneath the Seventh Floor.<NL>We sent our finest scouts to investigate, but they never returned and left no message..."
2a3b1a5e-3c32-4558-a704-412e32b485d4/Eve.cn: “孰料近来渊底常传出阵阵异响，恍若千军万马在渊下鏖战，<NL>诸多弟子下渊后便一去不返，门中的委托也多有耽搁……<NL><NL>且那怪声的来处，似乎还在渊底第七层之下，<NL>此前有几位好手专程前往第七层去查探，结果竟是一去不回，沓无音讯……”

2a3b1a5e-3c32-4558-a704-412e32b485d4/Opt.en: The strange noise originates from below the seventh layer...
2a3b1a5e-3c32-4558-a704-412e32b485d4/Opt.cn: 怪声源自在第七层之下……
2a3b1a5e-3c32-4558-a704-412e32b485d4/Opt.ru: Странный шум исходит из-под седьмого слоя...

9f0ae7fd-d0d5-4ae9-b8a7-86d0da86ac6f/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is listening intently when suddenly a soft voice calls from behind,"<NL><NL>You have come."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns and sees Yu Chan standing quietly just a few steps away. It's unclear how long she has been waiting there...
9f0ae7fd-d0d5-4ae9-b8a7-86d0da86ac6f/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正凝神细听，忽闻身后一声轻唤：<NL><NL>“你来了。”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>回身望去，只见玉蝉已静立于数步之外，不知已在此候了多久……
9f0ae7fd-d0d5-4ae9-b8a7-86d0da86ac6f/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> внимательно прислушивается, как вдруг сзади раздается тихий голос: "<NL><NL>Ты пришел."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> оборачивается и видит Ю Чана, спокойно стоящего всего в нескольких шагах от него. Неясно, как долго она там прождала...

9f0ae7fd-d0d5-4ae9-b8a7-86d0da86ac6f/Opt.en: I never go back on my words...
9f0ae7fd-d0d5-4ae9-b8a7-86d0da86ac6f/Opt.ru: Я никогда не отказываюсь от своих слов...

3b3cc877-fc02-4a2f-b7c6-3224a9383e2a/Eve.en: Yu Chan says no more, her lips curving into a faint, clear smile.<NL>The two stand side by side at the edge of Wusheng Abyss. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> leans over and looks down. The abyss gapes like a grim, monstrous maw, silently awaiting its next visitor.<NL><NL>Yu Chan turns her head toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and says softly,<NL>"Shall we descend to take a look?"
3b3cc877-fc02-4a2f-b7c6-3224a9383e2a/Eve.cn: 玉蝉唇角微扬，漾出一抹清浅笑意，便未再多言。<NL>二人并立渊畔，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>俯身下望，无生渊仍旧张着阴森巨口，静候来人。<NL><NL>玉蝉侧首面向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，轻声道：<NL>“可要下渊一探？”

3b3cc877-fc02-4a2f-b7c6-3224a9383e2a/Opt.en: "Exactly what I had in mind!" (Leap down into the Abyss...)
3b3cc877-fc02-4a2f-b7c6-3224a9383e2a/Opt.ru: "Именно это я и имел в виду!" (Прыжок вниз, в бездну...)

f4fad7c5-3a62-4460-aa4e-1cc39c035a91/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> pushes off the cliff face with the tip of a foot and leaps into the Abyss. At almost the same moment, Yu Chan darts forward, close behind.<NL>Two figures plunge toward the boundless depths and vanish into the darkness...
f4fad7c5-3a62-4460-aa4e-1cc39c035a91/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>足尖一点崖壁，纵身下渊。玉蝉几乎同时掠出，紧跟在后。<NL>两道身影倏忽没入黑暗之中，向着无尽深渊坠去……
f4fad7c5-3a62-4460-aa4e-1cc39c035a91/Eve.ru: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> отталкивается от скалы кончиком ноги и прыгает в пропасть. Почти в тот же момент Ю Чан бросается вперед, оказавшись совсем рядом.<NL>Две фигуры ныряют в бескрайние глубины и исчезают в темноте...

4079f141-7b82-417b-9878-f61919f5a48d/Eve.en: After several descents and landings, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Yu Chan reach the seventh layer of Wusheng Abyss.<NL>Though the gloom around them remains thick, the sound of clashing weapons echoes endlessly against the walls.<NL>Yu Chan tilts her head and listens for a moment, her brows slightly furrowed...
4079f141-7b82-417b-9878-f61919f5a48d/Eve.cn: 身形几番起落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玉蝉便已掠至无生渊第七层。<NL>周遭幽暗依旧，却有阵阵金戈声在渊壁间久久回荡。<NL>玉蝉侧耳侧耳听了片刻，眉头微蹙……

4079f141-7b82-417b-9878-f61919f5a48d/Opt.en: No matter. Let's investigate further following the sound...
4079f141-7b82-417b-9878-f61919f5a48d/Opt.ru: Неважно. Давайте продолжим расследование, следуя за звуком...

5f3760d7-7088-4e3c-8f2f-b4ebd58e60b7/Eve.en: Yu Chan nods and follows <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> toward the noise.<NL>The deeper they go, the more deafening the clash of arms becomes, as if thousands of soldiers and horses are locked in fierce battle deep beneath the earth.<NL><NL>The two wander and search, not knowing how long they have traveled.<NL>Not until they stop do they find themselves in the very place where they once encountered Zhen Wanshan.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> listens carefully, only to find that the sound is the clearest of all here with echoes coming from all sides...
5f3760d7-7088-4e3c-8f2f-b4ebd58e60b7/Eve.cn: 玉蝉颔首，与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>循声而往，<NL>愈往深处，铿锵之声越是震耳欲聋，恍若千军万马正于地底酣战不休。<NL><NL>二人辗转寻觅，不知行了多久，<NL>待到停下脚步，便已身处从前遇见真万善之地，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>侧耳细辨，只觉四壁皆作回响，那声响在此处竟是最为清晰……

5f3760d7-7088-4e3c-8f2f-b4ebd58e60b7/Opt.en: Zhen Wanshan once stood guard right here. Could it be that...
5f3760d7-7088-4e3c-8f2f-b4ebd58e60b7/Opt.cn: 真万善昔日便是守在此处，莫非……
5f3760d7-7088-4e3c-8f2f-b4ebd58e60b7/Opt.ru: Чжэнь Ваньшань когда-то стоял на страже прямо здесь. Могло ли это быть так?..

06fc277a-fb65-40a5-89ce-5a3b2bdf6cfd/Eve.en: Upon hearing this, Yu Chan nods and replies,<NL><NL>"The cyan flame over my heart seems to sense something. Lady Asura must be right here.<NL>But when I came here last time, it was just as empty as this. There was no trace of her, nor any sign of the missing Jieqing Sect disciples."<NL><NL>Before her voice fades, the rumbling strange sounds from the bottom of the Abyss abruptly cease.<NL>In an instant, the clamor vanishes entirely, leaving utter silence all around...
06fc277a-fb65-40a5-89ce-5a3b2bdf6cfd/Eve.cn: 玉蝉闻言，颔首应道：<NL><NL>“我心口的青焰似有感应，修罗女想必就在此处，<NL>只是我前次来探时，也是这般空无一物，既无她的踪迹，亦无失踪的界青门人。”<NL><NL>话音未落，渊底沉沉回荡的怪声竟戛然而止，<NL>喧嚣一时退尽，四周须臾间静得再无半点声息……

06fc277a-fb65-40a5-89ce-5a3b2bdf6cfd/Opt.ru: (Эта мертвая тишина не предвещает ничего хорошего...)

2284774c-53e7-4072-a53e-a66736ec29b6/Eve.en: Just as <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is wondering, a tremor suddenly comes from the bag at his side.<NL>He reaches in and takes out an object. The Demon-Severing Bone, obtained long ago at Mount Yuan, is now humming incessantly for no apparent reason.<NL>Yu Chan also notices the strange movement of the Demon-Severing Bone. Her brows furrow in worry...
2284774c-53e7-4072-a53e-a66736ec29b6/Eve.cn: 正诧异间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>忽觉身侧行囊忽传来震颤，<NL>探手取出一看，竟是昔日于元山所得的绝魔骨，此刻正无端嗡鸣不止，<NL>玉蝉亦察觉到绝魔骨的异动，不由得眉头紧锁……

2284774c-53e7-4072-a53e-a66736ec29b6/Opt.en: Demon-Severing Bone... Why is it reacting like this? (Stay on guard...)
2284774c-53e7-4072-a53e-a66736ec29b6/Opt.cn: 绝魔骨……怎会有这般异动？（小心戒备……）
2284774c-53e7-4072-a53e-a66736ec29b6/Opt.ru: Кость, разрываемая демоном... Почему он так реагирует? (Оставайся начеку...)

32cbb043-6142-4046-a449-c4cba70510c8/Eve.en: All at once, a thunderous boom erupts from deep underground, as if a lightning bolt has split the rock layers apart.<NL>Countless cracks spread beneath their feet. Shattered stones tumble down with dust and smoke.<NL> <NL>In just a few breaths, the entire Abyss floor shakes violently.<NL>Rocks pour down like rain. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Yu Chan find themselves with nowhere left to stand!
32cbb043-6142-4046-a449-c4cba70510c8/Eve.cn: 猝然间，地底深处轰然震响，恍若惊雷撕裂岩层，<NL>二人足下顿生无数龟裂，乱石裹挟着烟尘簌簌坠落。<NL> <NL>不过数息，整个渊底已是天摇地动，<NL>碎石如雨倾泻而下，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>和玉蝉竟再无一处立足之地！

27838535-1737-404c-81e1-bf33676e828b/Eve.en: The two make their decision without delay and turn swiftly in midair.<NL>Tipping lightly off the flying debris, they vault and dodge, using the crumbling stones to propel themselves downward.<NL>After several twists and turns, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Yu Chan plunge into a deep, dark cavern...
27838535-1737-404c-81e1-bf33676e828b/Eve.cn: 二人当机立断，身形疾转，<NL>足尖轻点飞坠的乱石，辗转腾挪，于碎石崩落间借力而下。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>和玉蝉身形几度翻转，片刻后便落入幽深地穴之中……

1939c1f3-2872-4c9c-aae1-acf4284d2138/Eve.en: They fall like shooting stars. Beneath their feet is nothing but void.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Yu Chan focus their breath and protect their bodies as they plummet at great speed.<NL>The wind roars in their ears, and loose rocks graze past them. In moments, they fall into the depths of the cavern...
1939c1f3-2872-4c9c-aae1-acf4284d2138/Eve.cn: 二人脚下虚空，身坠如星。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与玉蝉于急速下坠中凝神提气，护住周身。<NL>二人耳边风声呼啸，乱石擦身而过，须臾间便落入幽深地穴之中……

7353bb88-0dba-4449-815a-5f52a5490486/Eve.en: The two have no way to brace themselves, and fall together with the collapsing stones into the deep, dark cavern.<NL>By the time they land, the dust and debris have yet to settle. Covered in dirt and grime, they have gained a few new wounds as well...
7353bb88-0dba-4449-815a-5f52a5490486/Eve.cn: 二人无从借力，只得随崩石一同坠入幽深地穴之中。<NL>待落定时，碎石扬尘尚未散尽，二人已是灰头土脸，亦添了几道伤痕……
7353bb88-0dba-4449-815a-5f52a5490486/Eve.ru: У этих двоих нет возможности собраться с силами, и они падают вместе с рушащимися камнями в глубокую темную пещеру.<NL>К тому времени, когда они приземляются, пыль и обломки еще не успели осесть. Покрытые грязью и копотью, они также получили несколько новых ран...

b3664de8-3a7f-42c8-9381-df960d6d39ff/Eve.en: Once the two have landed, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> looks around. It's a dark and cramped place faintly tinged with the scent of blood.<NL>By the dim light, there is no sign of the so-called "thousands of troops and horses" . Only a few figures are lying sprawled on the ground.<NL>Judging by their attire, they are all disciples of the Jieqing Sect...
b3664de8-3a7f-42c8-9381-df960d6d39ff/Eve.cn: 待二人落定，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>举目四顾，只见此处幽暗逼仄，隐有血腥之气浮动。<NL>借着微光看去，并无所谓的千军万马，唯有数人横陈于地，<NL>看衣着装束，皆是界青门人……

b3664de8-3a7f-42c8-9381-df960d6d39ff/Opt.en: How come disciples of the Jieqing Sect got trapped beneath the earth...
b3664de8-3a7f-42c8-9381-df960d6d39ff/Opt.cn: 界青门弟子怎会陷于这地底之下……
b3664de8-3a7f-42c8-9381-df960d6d39ff/Opt.ru: Как получилось, что ученики Секты Цзецин оказались в ловушке под землей?..

f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Eve.en: Following the scent of blood, Yu Chan approaches the figures, bends down to feel their pulses, and whispers after a moment:<NL><NL>"They're indeed the Jieqing Sect disciples who went missing recently...<NL>They are still alive, but injured severely..."
f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Eve.cn: 玉蝉循着血气步至那几人身旁，俯身搭脉，片刻后低声道：<NL><NL>“是他们……近日失踪的界青门弟子……<NL>尚有气息，只是伤势不轻……”
f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Eve.ru: Следуя за запахом крови, Ю Чан приближается к фигурам, наклоняется, чтобы пощупать их пульс, и через мгновение шепчет:<NL><NL>"Они действительно ученики Секты Цзецин, которые недавно пропали без вести...<NL>Они все еще живы, но тяжело ранены..."

f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Opt.en: Could it be Lady Asura who did this...
f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Opt.cn: 莫非是那修罗女伤了他们……
f46e8a2c-38c0-46f0-be95-3d6510b9ca5d/Opt.ru: Могла ли это сделать леди Асура?..

8bc28119-6273-4f73-b83f-ec1333b2c664/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is lost in doubt when a rustling sound suddenly emerges from the darkness.<NL>A young girl steps out of the gloom with a green glimmer flashing in her eyes, her hair disheveled, her clothes tattered.<NL>The moment she takes a step, her body lunges forward to charge violently at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, her eyes blazing with ferocity!
8bc28119-6273-4f73-b83f-ec1333b2c664/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正疑惑间，暗处忽起一阵窸窣之声，<NL>一少女自幽暗中步出，乱发破衣，双目青芒闪烁，<NL>她脚步方才迈出，身形已然暴起，双目凶光毕露，向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>疾袭而来！

8160470b-9f7b-47f2-97dd-558e200470d9/Eve.en: The young girl, struck in a vital spot by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, staggers back a few steps, a trace of blood oozing from the corner of her mouth.<NL>Yet, in but a moment, she completely recovers from her injuries and grins widely:<NL><NL>"Interesting! Come on, let's trade a few more blows!"<NL><NL>Before her voice fades, she has already launched another fierce assault. Yu Chan immediately springs forward, barely managing to block her.<NL>Using the force to push back, the young girl changes her stance and resumes her attack, each move ruthless, her offensive growing ever fiercer!
8160470b-9f7b-47f2-97dd-558e200470d9/Eve.cn: 那少女被<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>击中要害，踉跄退开数步，唇角溢出血丝。<NL>岂料不过片刻，她竟全然恢复了伤势，咧嘴一笑：<NL><NL>“有意思，且再与我过两招！”<NL><NL>话音未落，人已疾袭而至，玉蝉当即抢身而出，堪堪将其挡下，<NL>那少女借力退开，旋即变招复攻，招招狠辣，攻势愈猛！

8160470b-9f7b-47f2-97dd-558e200470d9/Opt.en: (Didn't expect that she fights with such cruelty...)
8160470b-9f7b-47f2-97dd-558e200470d9/Opt.ru: (Не ожидал, что она дерется с такой жестокостью...)

94942148-9e12-45dd-87d0-31b4c999b18b/Eve.en: After several intense clashes, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> is overwhelmed and falls into grave danger.<NL>The young girl stands a few paces away, her face alight with manic joy, her eyes blazing with green light. She is about to pounce again.<NL><NL>Alarmed by the sight, Yu Chan rushes to stand before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, barely deflecting the incoming strike.<NL>But the young girl uses the force to leap back, spins around, and resumes her assault, each move vicious, her attacks growing ever more violent..
94942148-9e12-45dd-87d0-31b4c999b18b/Eve.cn: 激战数合之后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>终是不敌，一时险象环生。<NL>那少女立于数步之外，面露狂喜，眸中青色大盛，正欲再扑上前。<NL><NL>玉蝉见状大惊，疾身挡于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>身前，堪堪将来招挡下，<NL>那少女却借力退开，旋身复攻，招招狠辣，攻势愈猛……

943e3875-89db-4f47-b567-8c942c20f98d/Eve.en: Jade Cicada exchanged several moves with the young girl. Amidst the exchange of techniques, the girl suddenly paused,<NL>after parrying one of Jade Cicada's moves, her gaze pierced like an awl into Jade Cicada's face: "You... have the aura of azure flame on you."<NL><NL>Without waiting for Jade Cicada's reply, she spat the blood in her mouth to the side:<NL>"Forget it, let's finish the fight first!"<NL><NL>As soon as the words fell, the girl moved, and her Strikes resumed, charging swiftly at Jade Cicada!
943e3875-89db-4f47-b567-8c942c20f98d/Eve.cn: 玉蝉与那少女交手数合，招式往来间，少女却忽然身形一滞，<NL>格开玉蝉一招后，目光如锥般钉在玉蝉脸上：“你身上……有青焰的气息。”<NL><NL>不待玉蝉作答，她已将口中血水往旁一啐：<NL>“罢了，先打完再说！”<NL><NL>话音方落，少女身形已动，攻势再起，向玉蝉疾袭而去！

fb061e22-6474-486c-9a92-b3cefecb6221/Eve.en: Yu Chan crosses blows with her for a few more rounds, but the young girl suddenly halts her attack and speaks in a low voice:<NL><NL>"You... you carry the scent of the cyan flame."<NL><NL>Without awaiting Yu Chan's response, she spits the blood from her mouth to the side. "Forget it! Let's finish fighting first!"<NL>With that, she launches another fierce attack and hurtles toward Yu Chan!
fb061e22-6474-486c-9a92-b3cefecb6221/Eve.cn: 玉蝉与其交手数合，那少女却忽然收了手，沉声道：<NL><NL>“你身上……有青焰的气息。”<NL><NL>不待玉蝉作答，她将口中血水往旁一啐：“罢了，先打完再说！”<NL>言罢攻势再起，向玉蝉疾袭而去！

34b74fbd-6c21-44e7-8015-32f2db09a825/Eve.en: Yu Chan engages her in battle, while <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> focuses intently on the fight, doubts gradually arising in their heart—<NL><NL>This young girl's moves are exceptionally ferocious, but devoid of any killing intent; rather, she seems only to seek the joy of a spirited bout.<NL>Combined with her self-healing body, it becomes clear that she must be Lady Asura Zhen Wanshan has guarded for centuries at this place.<NL>Yet, every time she strikes, there is a fleeting stiffness...
34b74fbd-6c21-44e7-8015-32f2db09a825/Eve.cn: 玉蝉与其战于一处，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>凝神观战，心下却渐起疑窦——<NL><NL>这少女出招异常凶猛，却无半分杀气，倒像只图酣战之乐。<NL>加之其非人的自愈之躯，想来定是真万善在此守了数百年的修罗女。<NL>唯独其出招之时，总有瞬间的滞涩……

34b74fbd-6c21-44e7-8015-32f2db09a825/Opt.en: (As if long trapped in the abyss, her power remains shackled, thus unable to fully unleash...)
34b74fbd-6c21-44e7-8015-32f2db09a825/Opt.cn: （似是久困渊底，她体内的力量尚受桎梏，未能尽数施展……）
34b74fbd-6c21-44e7-8015-32f2db09a825/Opt.ru: (Словно надолго запертая в бездне, ее сила остается скованной, поэтому она не может полностью высвободиться...)

00c24ec7-77f2-4bfa-a94e-0cfa97485cda/Eve.en: Even so, Yu Chan is gradually losing ground.<NL>In a flash of insight, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> suddenly recalls that it was the violent tremor of the Demon-Severing Bone that caused the abyss to collapse earlier.<NL><NL>The Demon-Severing Bone contains the Three Forces Qi left by Nüwa when she molded the earth, thus no mortal object;<NL>And Lady Asura before them is also no being of the mortal realm. Now, the strange movements of the Demon-Severing Bone may be drawn by her aura...
00c24ec7-77f2-4bfa-a94e-0cfa97485cda/Eve.cn: 即便如此，玉蝉仍旧逐渐落入了下风。<NL>心念电转间，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>猛然回想起，方才正是绝魔骨突生剧震，才引得渊底崩塌。<NL><NL>绝魔骨内蕴女娲抟土时所留的三才之气，本非凡间凡物；<NL>而眼前这修罗女，亦非凡界生灵，此刻绝魔骨异动频频，或受了她气息的牵引……

00c24ec7-77f2-4bfa-a94e-0cfa97485cda/Opt.en: (Perhaps, I can use this object to distract her and save Yu Chan from peril...)(Produce the Demon-Severing Bone...)
00c24ec7-77f2-4bfa-a94e-0cfa97485cda/Opt.cn: （或可借此物分她心神，解玉蝉之危……）（取出绝魔骨……）
00c24ec7-77f2-4bfa-a94e-0cfa97485cda/Opt.ru: (Возможно, я смогу использовать этот предмет, чтобы отвлечь ее и спасти Ю Чан от опасности...)(Достань кость, разделяющую демонов...)

014cbac0-93d0-4efb-86d0-f3b267ec7ba7/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> does not hesitate and reaches out to take out the Demon-Severing Bone.<NL>As soon as the object appears, the young girl seems to sense it. With her assault abruptly ceasing,<NL>she swiftly turns her head to stare at the object in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand.<NL><NL>"You... where did you get this?"
014cbac0-93d0-4efb-86d0-f3b267ec7ba7/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>更不迟疑，探手将绝魔骨取出。<NL>此物方一现出，那少女便似有所感，只见其攻势骤收，猛然回首望来，<NL>直盯着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手中之物：<NL><NL>“你……你从何处得来此物？”

014cbac0-93d0-4efb-86d0-f3b267ec7ba7/Opt.en: It's a long story. Stop your attack first!
014cbac0-93d0-4efb-86d0-f3b267ec7ba7/Opt.cn: 此物来历，说来话长，你且先住手！
014cbac0-93d0-4efb-86d0-f3b267ec7ba7/Opt.ru: Это долгая история. Сначала останови свою Атаку!

f84dd4cc-df91-4c33-a511-aceeabb59c92/Eve.en: The young girl remains silent for a long while, her gaze shifting back and forth between the Demon-Severing Bone and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>Finally, with a cold snort, she withdraws her attack, turns her head away, and falls silent.<NL><NL>Taking the chance to catch her breath, Yu Chan asks the young girl in a deep voice,<NL>"Are you Lady Asura?"
f84dd4cc-df91-4c33-a511-aceeabb59c92/Eve.cn: 那少女沉默半晌，目光在绝魔骨与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>之间来回游移，<NL>末了冷哼一声，收起攻势别过头去，闭口不言。<NL><NL>玉蝉趁隙喘息稍定，沉声向那少女问道：<NL>“你便是那修罗女？”

4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Eve.en: Upon her words, a flash of hatred glimmers in the young girl's eyes. She sneers.<NL><NL>"Didn't expect you to know my identity.<NL>Who sent you two here? Was it my brother Zhen Wan'e?<NL>My divine power has been restored. Never think you can take my life!"
4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Eve.cn: 那少女闻言，眸中闪过一丝恨意，冷笑道：<NL><NL>“你竟知晓我的身份。<NL>是谁派你二人来此，是那哥哥万恶？<NL>我如今神力已复，你二人休想取我性命！”
4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Eve.ru: При ее словах в глазах молодой девушки вспыхивает ненависть. Она усмехается.<NL><NL>- Не ожидал, что вы знаете, кто я такой.<NL>Кто послал вас двоих сюда? Это был мой брат Чжэнь Ваньэ?<NL>Моя божественная сила была восстановлена. Никогда не думай, что сможешь отнять у меня жизнь!"

4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Opt.en: We came here under nobody's order. Zhen Wan'e is already dead. We're here to investigate the strange sounds...
4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Opt.cn: 无人派我们来此地。真万恶已死，我等只为查探怪声而来……
4ccf3ebd-c909-4f94-bf00-4c314ffea045/Opt.ru: Мы пришли сюда ни по чьему приказу. Чжэнь Ваньэ уже мертва. Мы здесь для того, чтобы разобраться в странных звуках...

0eacbcb8-a658-4c5f-ba47-0a160f09d67d/Eve.en: The young girl pauses briefly upon hearing this. The ferocity in her eyes lessens somewhat. Her brows knit together.<NL><NL>"Wan'e is dead... then what about my younger brother Wanshan?<NL>He has guarded me here for several hundred years. Not long ago, he left a strand of true qi to protect me, and rushed away in haste.<NL>Where did he go? Has some misfortune befallen him?"
0eacbcb8-a658-4c5f-ba47-0a160f09d67d/Eve.cn: 少女闻言微微一怔，眸中戾气稍减，眉头蹙起：<NL><NL>“万恶死了……那弟弟万善呢？<NL>他在此守了我数百年，不久前留下一缕真气护我，便匆匆离去。<NL>他去了何处，可是遭了什么不测？”

0eacbcb8-a658-4c5f-ba47-0a160f09d67d/Opt.en: He can no longer guard you here...
0eacbcb8-a658-4c5f-ba47-0a160f09d67d/Opt.cn: 他已无法再在此守护你了……
0eacbcb8-a658-4c5f-ba47-0a160f09d67d/Opt.ru: Он больше не может охранять тебя здесь...

6b6ace55-373e-4a74-b6ab-9bc96a93ba3c/Eve.en: Hearing this, the girl's expression was filled with undisguisable fury and anxiety, she said repeatedly:<NL><NL>"So he did meet with a mishap, did he perish together with his brother?<NL>You two just said Malevolence is dead, so I cannot avenge him?!"<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> saw the anxiety in her eyes, and thought she truly cared for the real Benevolence,<NL>since she was a person of deep Feeling and Favor, perhaps the matters outside the abyss could be told to her as well...
6b6ace55-373e-4a74-b6ab-9bc96a93ba3c/Eve.cn: 少女闻言，神情中满是掩不住的焦怒，连声道：<NL><NL>“他果然是遭了变故，可是与他那哥哥同归于尽了？<NL>你二人方才说万恶既已身死，我竟也无法为他报仇了？！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>见她眸中焦灼，想来她对真万善确是真心挂怀，<NL>既是重情重义之人，渊外之事，或可一并告知于她……

6b6ace55-373e-4a74-b6ab-9bc96a93ba3c/Opt.en: (Tell her everything about the events beyond the abyss one by one...)
6b6ace55-373e-4a74-b6ab-9bc96a93ba3c/Opt.ru: (Расскажи ей все о событиях по ту сторону бездны, одно за другим...)

350eb793-18cc-4e03-9ebd-e27efec7cbc9/Eve.en: After hearing this, the girl looked somewhat dejected and simply said:<NL><NL>"I see... Thanks to you, Successor of Taiwu, for killing Malevolence.<NL>Otherwise, I couldn't even leave this Demise Abyss, how could I avenge him..."<NL><NL>With that, she lowered her eyes and fell silent, as if pressing centuries of Favor onto her heart...
350eb793-18cc-4e03-9ebd-e27efec7cbc9/Eve.cn: 少女听罢神情有些落寞，只道：<NL><NL>“原来如此……多亏你太吾传人出手杀了万恶。<NL>否则我连这无生渊都出不去，该如何为他报仇……”<NL><NL>言罢便垂目不语，似将这数百年的恩义皆压在了心口……

350eb793-18cc-4e03-9ebd-e27efec7cbc9/Opt.en: But... from watching you fight just now, it seems your power has not yet fully recovered?
350eb793-18cc-4e03-9ebd-e27efec7cbc9/Opt.cn: 只是……方才观你出手，似乎力量尚未尽复？
350eb793-18cc-4e03-9ebd-e27efec7cbc9/Opt.ru: Но... судя по тому, как ты сейчас сражаешься, твоя сила еще не полностью восстановилась?

ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Eve.en: The young girl nods and then lets out a self-mocking smile after a while.<NL><NL>"My name is Alina, a proud member of the Asura Clan. I once followed my king to wage war against the Heavenly Emperor that shook the entire universe!<NL>Now that I've fallen into your mortal realm, even though I recover some of my strength, I still cannot even get out of this Wusheng Abyss..."<NL><NL>Her gaze falls once more upon the Demon-Severing Bone in <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s hand, as if she wants to say something but holds back...
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Eve.cn: 少女点点头，片刻后却又自嘲一笑：<NL><NL>“我名为阿黎那，乃是堂堂阿修罗一族，曾随吾王讨伐天帝，一战便可震动寰宇！<NL>如今落入你们这番天地，即便恢复了些许气力，却仍是连这区区无生渊都出不去……”<NL><NL>言罢，其目光再度落向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手中的绝魔骨，似是欲言又止……

ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.en: Are the strange sounds from the depths of the abyss caused by your recovery of power?
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.cn: 渊底传来的怪声，可是因你恢复力量而生？
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.ru: Вызваны ли странные звуки, доносящиеся из глубин бездны, восстановлением вашей силы?

ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.en: Did you hurt those Jieqing Sect disciples?
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.cn: 这些界青门弟子可都是你所伤？
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.ru: Ты причинил вред тем ученикам Секты Цзецин?

ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.en: You mean this Demon-Severing Bone can help you recover your power?
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.cn: 言下之意，这绝魔骨可助你恢复力量？
ea17875e-1831-475f-96db-22b0a9488577/Opt.ru: Ты хочешь сказать, что эта кость, разделяющая демонов, может помочь тебе восстановить свою силу?

82e5b1c4-d6eb-49c0-8158-33e1cbbe97d9/Eve.en: Alina nodded:<NL><NL>"That battle... the enemy was powerful, our side suffered a crushing defeat, and all who followed perished.<NL>I was also severely wounded, falling into your world along with a Silent Star.<NL><NL>That was the aftermath of the great war, sealed within the Silent Star.<NL>I have been trapped here for a long time, and the Silent Star has also been imprisoned underground with me, originally silent and soundless.<NL>It was only when some of my power returned that the noise leaked out..."
82e5b1c4-d6eb-49c0-8158-33e1cbbe97d9/Eve.cn: 阿黎那点点头：<NL><NL>“那一役……敌方势大，我方惨败，随征者尽数陨落。<NL>我亦身负重伤，随一颗寂星坠入你们这方世界<NL><NL>那是当年大战的余响，封于寂星之中。<NL>我沉沦此地日久，寂星亦随我一同困于地底，本是无声无息。<NL>直至我几分力量得以回返，那声响方才泄出……”

d1973311-8ed9-4ba5-8a06-9623b8b241d0/Eve.en: Alina turns to the figures lying on the ground and says,<NL><NL>"I haven't fought for ages. Now that part of my strength has returned, I wish to stretch my limbs a little.<NL>Who knows they would suffer severe injuries this easily."<NL><NL>Then she looks toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and says,<NL>"As for you two, you manage to withstand several of my blows..."
d1973311-8ed9-4ba5-8a06-9623b8b241d0/Eve.cn: 阿黎那望向躺在地上的数人，只道：<NL><NL>“我久未交手，既见有人来到此地，又觉气力稍复，便想活动活动筋骨。<NL>谁知这般不经打，不过三两招便令他们受了重伤。”<NL><NL>随即又望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>道：<NL>“倒是你二人，竟能接我数招……”

c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Eve.en: Alina nodded:<NL><NL>"The aura of this thing in your hand is not of the mortal world,<NL>using the Clear Qi within as a guide, it can help me recall all my power.<NL>If you are willing to lend it to me, I will owe you a Favor..."
c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Eve.cn: 阿黎那颔首道：<NL><NL>“你手中此物的气息并非凡间所有，<NL>借其中清气为引，当可助我召回所有的力量，<NL>你若肯借我一用，我便欠你一个人情……”
c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Eve.ru: Алина кивнула:<NL><NL>- Аура этой штуки в твоей руке не принадлежит миру смертных,<NL>используя внутреннюю чистую Ци в качестве ориентира, это может помочь мне вспомнить всю мою силу.<NL>Если вы готовы одолжить его мне, я буду у вас в долгу..."

c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Opt.en: What's your plan after your power recovers?
c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Opt.cn: 若恢复了力量，可有何打算？
c7adebf0-655f-495d-acce-99ec21e75b8f/Opt.ru: Каков твой план после того, как твои силы восстановятся?

3342542c-79ff-4757-9ef9-91e4db63a997/Eve.en: Alina gives a soft laugh and continues,<NL>"Only by recovering my power can I leave this place beneath the earth.<NL>My grievances in your human realm are now settled. I have no attachments left, nor any intention to linger.<NL><NL>I only wish to return to my king's side and fight for my king once more.<NL>If you refuse, I will not force you."
3342542c-79ff-4757-9ef9-91e4db63a997/Eve.cn: 阿黎那轻笑一声，继续道：<NL>“恢复了力量，我方能离开这地底，<NL>我于你们人间的恩怨已了，如今毫无眷恋，亦无意逗留。<NL><NL>我只想回到吾王身边，再为吾王而战。<NL>你若不肯，我亦不会强求。”

4648c53e-8901-4ed3-b7ca-37317a11cd2b/Eve.en: Hearing these words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turns to the Demon-Severing Bone in their palm and thinks to themselves.<NL><NL>As aggressive as always, Alina injured many Jieqing Sect disciples, but she didn't kill them.<NL>Now all she seeks is to take back what belongs to her and return to her homeland. Perhaps, it is right to help her...<NL><NL>Yu Chan, who has been silent for a long while, gently tugs at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s sleeve and gives a slight nod...
4648c53e-8901-4ed3-b7ca-37317a11cd2b/Eve.cn: 听得此言，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>望向掌中绝魔骨，心中暗忖，<NL><NL>阿黎那虽生性好战，伤了诸多界青门人，却终究未下死手，<NL>如今所求不过取回己身之物，归返故土而已，或可出手相助……<NL><NL>一旁沉默许久的玉蝉亦轻扯了一下<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>的衣袖，轻轻颔首……

4648c53e-8901-4ed3-b7ca-37317a11cd2b/Opt.en: In that case, I will lend you the Demon-Severing Bone... (Hand the Demon-Severing Bone to Alina...)
4648c53e-8901-4ed3-b7ca-37317a11cd2b/Opt.cn: 既然如此，那我便将绝魔骨借你一用……（将绝魔骨递给阿黎那……）
4648c53e-8901-4ed3-b7ca-37317a11cd2b/Opt.ru: В таком случае, я одолжу тебе Кость, разделяющую демонов... (Передайте Алине кость, разделяющую демонов...)

d21832d7-04f8-46f5-90fa-e04509844ea1/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hands the ever-trembling Demon-Severing Bone to Alina.<NL>Alina reaches out and takes it, a look of joy appearing on her face.<NL><NL>"We of the Asura clan always distinguish clearly between kindness and enmity.<NL>Since I owe you a favor, I will never go back on my word."
d21832d7-04f8-46f5-90fa-e04509844ea1/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>将震颤不止的绝魔骨递向阿黎那，<NL>阿黎那伸手接过，面露喜色：<NL><NL>“我阿修罗一族素来恩怨分明，<NL>既说了欠你人情，便绝不会反悔。”

cbfe9eb0-191e-4d3c-a71c-96cc098c1a8d/Eve.en: Alina then placed the Demonbane Bone in her palm, closed her eyes and concentrated,<NL>In an instant, the Clear and Turbid Qi within the Demonbane Bone surged out, twining and spiraling in the air for a moment before slowly converging into her brow.<NL>Alina's aura surged, Astragale rose all around, her Qi Circulation was sharp and fierce, no longer comparable to before...
cbfe9eb0-191e-4d3c-a71c-96cc098c1a8d/Eve.cn: 阿黎那随即将绝魔骨置于掌中，阖目凝神，<NL>刹那间，绝魔骨中的清浊二气翻涌而出，于空中交缠盘旋片刻后，便徐徐汇入其眉心。<NL>阿黎那周身气息暴涨，罡风四起，气势凌厉，已非方才可比……

815f6f27-cb7c-4426-a766-6a290af75903/Eve.en: After a short while, Alina's eyes open gently. The green light in her pupils grows even stronger, and the corners of her lips curl upward. "It is done."<NL>She then raises her hand to toss the Demon-Severing Bone back to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, only to see that the object in her palm has already turned to fine dust trickling down between her fingers.<NL>Alina freezes for a moment, and then shrugs her shoulders. Looking at the two, she says helplessly,<NL><NL>"Oh well... then I owe you an extra favor. Let me take you both out of this place first."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(Demon-Severing Bone is gone...)</color>
815f6f27-cb7c-4426-a766-6a290af75903/Eve.cn: 片刻之后，阿黎那双眸轻启，瞳中青色愈盛，唇角微扬：“成了。”<NL>随即抬手欲将绝魔骨抛还<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，却见掌中之物已化作齑粉，自指缝间簌簌滑落。<NL>阿黎那微微一怔，旋即耸了耸肩，望向二人，无奈道：<NL><NL>“罢了……如此便多还你一份人情，我先带你们离开此地罢。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（失去绝魔骨……）</color>

815f6f27-cb7c-4426-a766-6a290af75903/Opt.en: It's easy for you to run up a debt... Jade Cicada and I can find our own way up.Why would we need you to lead the way?
815f6f27-cb7c-4426-a766-6a290af75903/Opt.cn: 这人情倒是欠得干脆……我与玉蝉自可回到渊上，何须由你带我二人离开？
815f6f27-cb7c-4426-a766-6a290af75903/Opt.ru: Вам легко влезть в долги... Мы с Цикадой Нефрит сами найдем дорогу наверх.Зачем нам нужно, чтобы вы указывали путь?

c01a54ca-2ae6-4f46-b959-64a48094b100/Eve.en: Alina flashes a light smile before her words fade.<NL>With a wave of her hand, a fierce wind suddenly rises beneath the feet of the three.<NL>That wind seems almost tangible. It swirls and lifts them upward.<NL>The wind whistles past <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s ears. Light and shadow flow before their eyes. In an instant, they soar out of the Wusheng Abyss and land on the Jieqing Cliff...
c01a54ca-2ae6-4f46-b959-64a48094b100/Eve.cn: 话音未落，阿黎那已扬起一抹轻笑。<NL>但见她抬手一挥，三人脚下罡风骤起，<NL>那风竟如有实质，盘旋托举，载着三人扶摇而上。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>耳畔风声猎猎，眼前光影流转，瞬息之间便已掠出无生渊，落于界青崖上……

c01a54ca-2ae6-4f46-b959-64a48094b100/Opt.cn: （恢复力量的阿黎那，竟有此能……）

c6176914-b84c-4dbe-b640-8c1f87c8acb2/Eve.en: The moment the three of them set foot on the cliff, Alina's eyes blaze to life, her burning gaze sweeping across the land.<NL>She slowly stretches her limbs, as if every sinew and bone awakens in the wind.<NL>Finally, she turns to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and Yu Chan, and says with a smile,<NL><NL>"Thank you. I can finally return to my king now."
c6176914-b84c-4dbe-b640-8c1f87c8acb2/Eve.cn: 三人足尖方触崖石，阿黎那眸光已倏然亮起，眼中灼灼环顾四野。<NL>她缓缓舒展肢体，仿若每一寸筋骨皆在长风里苏醒。<NL>末了转身望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>和玉蝉，笑道：<NL><NL>“多谢，如此一来，我便能重回到吾王身侧了。”

5c0a72fa-cef4-4d8c-8587-576c456caa7a/Eve.en: "But I owe you a debt..."<NL><NL>Alina pauses, her expression softening. After a moment of deep thought, she says solemnly,<NL><NL>"You not only eliminate evil in this mortal world but have slain Wan'e for me.<NL>Should you need help with crossing blades with demons in the future, I shall come to your aid..."
5c0a72fa-cef4-4d8c-8587-576c456caa7a/Eve.cn: “只是欠你这人情……”<NL><NL>阿黎那语气一顿，神色微敛，沉吟片刻后郑重道：<NL><NL>“你既是这人间降妖除魔之人，又除了那万恶，<NL>他日你若再与妖魔交手，但有所需，我自当相助……”

5c0a72fa-cef4-4d8c-8587-576c456caa7a/Opt.en: I will remember your words. Yet it may be hard to meet again after you leave this mortal realm...
5c0a72fa-cef4-4d8c-8587-576c456caa7a/Opt.cn: 此事我记下了，只是若你离了这人间，恐怕便再难相见……
5c0a72fa-cef4-4d8c-8587-576c456caa7a/Opt.ru: Я запомню твои слова. И все же, возможно, будет трудно встретиться снова после того, как вы покинете это царство смертных...

f8a85d79-3d47-43f5-be24-43e24be53d69/Eve.en: Hearing this, Alina chuckled lightly:<NL>"The world is vast, who can say for sure?<NL>The Asura clan has always been clear about Favor and resentment. Since I said I owe you a Favor, I will not break my word.<NL>When the time comes, even across a thousand mountains and ten thousand rivers, the Three Realms and Six Paths, I will find a way to come."<NL><NL>But as soon as the words fell, Alina's body swayed, staggered a few steps and nearly fell,<NL>the smile on her face stiffened, and her brow slightly furrowed...
f8a85d79-3d47-43f5-be24-43e24be53d69/Eve.cn: 阿黎那闻言，轻笑一声：<NL>“天地之大，谁又说得准？<NL>阿修罗一族，素来恩怨分明，既言欠你人情，便绝不会食言。<NL>届时纵隔千山万水、三界六道，我自有法子寻来。”<NL><NL>然话音刚落，阿黎那却身形一晃，踉跄数步险些跌倒，<NL>方才面上的笑意僵住，眉头亦微微蹙起……

7831e2b2-8679-45ae-9836-bd1870e5b9b6/Eve.en: Seeing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s heart tightens.<NL>Also sensing something amiss, Yu Chan rushes forward to steady her, but Alina raises a hand to stop her.<NL><NL>Alina looks down at her own hands. The once-solid fingers and palms begin to grow faint at the edges.<NL>A hazy glow starts to rise from her limbs and torso, as if she could dissolve at any moment...
7831e2b2-8679-45ae-9836-bd1870e5b9b6/Eve.cn: 见此情景，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>心下一凛，<NL>玉蝉亦有所感，抢步上前欲将其扶稳，阿黎那却抬手止住了她。<NL><NL>阿黎那垂眸望向自己的双手，那原本凝实的指掌，竟自边缘处渐渐透出几分虚淡，<NL>四肢躯干亦开始浮起一层朦胧的微光，恍若随时都会消散……

b92a3ba3-990f-4337-89a5-a655e3a563bd/Eve.en: Alina was stunned for a moment, then gave a bitter smile:<NL><NL>"So that's it... It should have been like this long ago...<NL>I suppose this body of mine... at some point must have already ceased to exist...<NL>In the confinement underground, it could barely hold together, but now seeing the light of day again, it can no longer... be retained."
b92a3ba3-990f-4337-89a5-a655e3a563bd/Eve.cn: 阿黎那怔了片刻，旋即苦笑一声：<NL><NL>“原来如此……早该如此……<NL>想来我这具躯壳……不知何时便早已不在了……<NL>地底幽闭，尚能勉强维系，如今重见天日，反倒……再也留不住了。”

5c64acc8-5d00-4861-82ca-da8497b6ed43/Eve.en: Alina looked at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>, the light in her eyes gradually dimming:<NL><NL>"That Favor of yours... it seems I cannot repay it.<NL>I should have fallen with my clan, turned to dust... but I was trapped here alone, clinging to life until now.<NL>Over the years I tried to recall victory, but what surges in my memory... is all the shame of defeat...<NL>And that Benevolence... I can no longer repay his kindness..."<NL><NL>Before her words were finished, Alina's form grew increasingly faint...
5c64acc8-5d00-4861-82ca-da8497b6ed43/Eve.cn: 阿黎那望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，眸中光芒渐趋黯淡：<NL><NL>“你那份人情……看来是还不上了。<NL>我本该与同族一同陨落，化为尘埃……却独独被困于此地，苟延至今。<NL>这些年我试图回忆胜利，可记忆中中翻涌的……尽是战败的耻辱……<NL>还有那万善……我再也还不了他的恩情……”<NL><NL>言犹未尽，阿黎那身形已愈发虚淡……

5c64acc8-5d00-4861-82ca-da8497b6ed43/Opt.en: Is there any way to save you?
5c64acc8-5d00-4861-82ca-da8497b6ed43/Opt.cn: 你的身体……可有何补救之法？
5c64acc8-5d00-4861-82ca-da8497b6ed43/Opt.ru: Есть ли какой-нибудь способ спасти тебя?

e964b380-c1a9-4453-9118-1ac62238201d/Eve.en: Alina shakes her head, but her gaze shifts to Yu Chan and speaks after studying her quietly for a moment,<NL><NL>"My body cannot be saved, but my soul remains.<NL>Since you carry my cyan flame over your heart, it seems... Wanshan also trusts you.<NL><NL>If you are willing to take in my soul, I can take shelter within you.<NL>One day, when conditions meet, perhaps, there may yet be a chance to reshape a body..."
e964b380-c1a9-4453-9118-1ac62238201d/Eve.cn: 阿黎那摇了摇头，目光却转向一旁的玉蝉，静静打量了片刻后，出言道：<NL><NL>“我这躯体已无可挽回，但魂灵尚存。<NL>你心口既有我的青焰，想来……万善亦曾信任你，<NL><NL>你若肯收容我这一缕残魂，我便能暂且栖身于你体内。<NL>他日因缘际会，或许……尚有重塑肉身的机缘……”

8ed7b9ae-c6ea-4bf0-a1a1-af64acf96c03/Eve.en: Yu Chan does not answer at first. Alina does not press her but merely says calmly,<NL><NL>"Of course, I will not force you. If you refuse, I will simply fade away.<NL>We Asura are born warriors. To die trapped in this mortal world... It would be the regret of my life..." Silent for a long time, Yu Chan turns toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> with a questioning look in her eyes...
8ed7b9ae-c6ea-4bf0-a1a1-af64acf96c03/Eve.cn: 玉蝉一时未答，阿黎那见状并不催促，只淡淡道：<NL><NL>“自然，我不会强求，你若不愿，我便就此消散。<NL>我等阿修罗，生来便是死士，身为死士，却困死于这凡尘之地……终为此生之憾……”<NL><NL>玉蝉沉默良久，侧首朝向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>，神色中似有询问之意……

8ed7b9ae-c6ea-4bf0-a1a1-af64acf96c03/Opt.en: Yu Chan, this is your life. Just follow your heart decide.
8ed7b9ae-c6ea-4bf0-a1a1-af64acf96c03/Opt.cn: 玉蝉，此缘在你，由你心意决断便可……
8ed7b9ae-c6ea-4bf0-a1a1-af64acf96c03/Opt.ru: Ю Чан, это твоя жизнь. Просто следуй решению своего сердца.

82d38d4c-dc62-4582-803b-5d62fa195219/Eve.en: Jade Cicada nodded slightly at this, but did not speak,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> turned to look at Alina, and saw her form was as faint as thin mist,<NL>only a pair of azure eyes still glowed dimly, without entreaty or urgency,<NL>only a silent and sharp waiting settled within.
82d38d4c-dc62-4582-803b-5d62fa195219/Eve.cn: 玉蝉闻言微微颔首，却未发一语，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>转头望向阿黎，却见其身形已淡如薄雾，<NL>唯有一双青色的眸子仍幽幽发亮，其中没有哀求，亦无急切，<NL>只沉淀着一片静默而又凌厉的等待。
82d38d4c-dc62-4582-803b-5d62fa195219/Eve.ru: Цикада Нефрит слегка кивнула в ответ на это, но ничего не сказала,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> повернулся, чтобы посмотреть на Алину, и увидел, что ее фигура была слабой, как тонкий туман,<NL>только пара лазурных глаз все еще тускло светилась, без мольбы или настойчивости,<NL>только безмолвное и острое ожидание поселилось внутри.

79949e3d-50aa-4e5e-93ea-74d536981815/Eve.en: "Okay."<NL><NL>Yu Chan breathes out the single word after a long pause.<NL>Alina is startled for a moment. Then a smile appears on her face.<NL><NL>"...Thank you."
79949e3d-50aa-4e5e-93ea-74d536981815/Eve.cn: “好。”<NL><NL>玉蝉沉默半晌，轻轻吐出一字。<NL>阿黎那微微一怔，旋即浮起一抹笑意：<NL><NL>“……多谢。”
79949e3d-50aa-4e5e-93ea-74d536981815/Eve.ru: "Ладно".<NL><NL>Ю Чан выдыхает единственное слово после долгой паузы.<NL>Алина на мгновение поражается. Затем на ее лице появляется улыбка.<NL><NL>"...Спасибо тебе".

363e0d58-5df8-484b-b029-d91b217e7958/Eve.en: Alina says no more and closes her eyes gently.<NL>In an instant, her body scatters into dazzling light and drifts softly in the air.<NL>They floats toward Yu Chan like fireflies and finally disappear into the space between her brows.<NL><NL>Yu Chan's body trembles slightly, as if something within her has quietly awakened.<NL>She concentrates for a moment. Between her brows, a touch of Alina's sharpness appears...
363e0d58-5df8-484b-b029-d91b217e7958/Eve.cn: 阿黎那未再多言，双目轻阖，<NL>须臾间，那残存的身形似星辉碎散而开，盈盈浮荡于空中<NL>而后如流萤般飘向玉蝉，最终没入其眉心。<NL><NL>玉蝉身形微微一颤，仿若有什么在她体内悄然苏醒。<NL>她凝神片刻，眉宇之间，竟添了几分阿黎那的凌厉之态……

363e0d58-5df8-484b-b029-d91b217e7958/Opt.en: Yu Chan, is there any discomfort?
363e0d58-5df8-484b-b029-d91b217e7958/Opt.ru: Ю Чан, есть ли какой-нибудь дискомфорт?

f043fa8b-4487-424e-9d65-b9d5473c182c/Eve.en: Yu Chan shakes her head after pondering for a moment.<NL><NL>"Nothing serious. There seems to be some murmurs within my consciousness.<NL>I suppose it's her voice..."<NL><NL>Before she finishes speaking, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> hears a soft click beneath their feet.<NL>Looking down, they see at the very spot where Alina had stood, an object lying quietly among the cracks in the stone<NL>emitting a warm, faint glow...
f043fa8b-4487-424e-9d65-b9d5473c182c/Eve.cn: 玉蝉沉吟片刻，随即摇头道：<NL><NL>“并无大碍，只是神识之中，似多了些呓语。<NL>想来应是她的声音……”<NL><NL>话音未落，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>却听得脚下却传来一声轻响。<NL>低头望去，便见方才阿黎那所立之处，有一物静静卧于石隙之间，<NL>正自内里透出温润薄光……

f043fa8b-4487-424e-9d65-b9d5473c182c/Opt.en: It is... (Reaches down to retrieve it...)
f043fa8b-4487-424e-9d65-b9d5473c182c/Opt.ru: Так и есть... (Наклоняется, чтобы поднять его...)

0e6d8a34-5d46-48c9-b212-c45e13e97b35/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> bent down and picked it up. The object was about the size of a fist,<NL>upon close inspection, faint specks of starlight could be seen flickering and flowing within,<NL>listening closely, one could faintly hear the clashing of metal weapons, as if that ancient great war still echoed in the depths of the Star River.
0e6d8a34-5d46-48c9-b212-c45e13e97b35/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>附身将其拾起，那物约莫拳头大小，<NL>仔细观瞧，可见内里隐有点点星芒明灭流转，<NL>侧耳倾听，依稀可闻金戈交鸣之声，恍若那场远古大战仍在星河深处回响。

22e4f3d2-e972-4510-857d-b8175b457452/Eve.en: Seemingly having sensed something, Yu Chan produces a smile.<NL><NL>"She says this was formed from the Silent Star that fell into this world together with her long ago. It might be of use to you.<NL>Consider it... as repayment for the loss of the Demon-Severing Bone."
22e4f3d2-e972-4510-857d-b8175b457452/Eve.cn: 玉蝉似有所感，笑道：<NL><NL>“她说，这是当年与她一同坠入此世的寂星所化，或可对你有用，<NL>权当……偿还那份绝魔骨的人情罢。”
22e4f3d2-e972-4510-857d-b8175b457452/Eve.ru: По-видимому, что-то почувствовав, Ю Чан выдает улыбку.<NL><NL>- Она говорит, что это образовалось из Безмолвной Звезды, которая давным-давно упала в этот мир вместе с ней. Это может быть вам полезно.<NL>Рассматривай это... как компенсацию за потерю Кости, Разделяющей Демонов."
